impact: NVENC DX11 interop documentation recommends D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_VIDEO_SUPPORT for reliable nvEncRegisterResource across driver versions and GPU generations. Absence may cause nvEncRegisterResource to fail on older drivers or with certain GPU generations when real DXGI capture is wired (T-048).
title: D3D11 device missing D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_VIDEO_SUPPORT flag for NVENC interop
